biotools.summary: BitBIRCH-Lean is a fast and memory-efficient implementation of the Bit-BIRCH algorithm designed for high-throughput clustering of molecular libraries. It utilizes optimized data structures and C++ extensions to achieve significant speedups for typical workstations.
